A_MULTIFRAME_MULTIMODAL_PROMPT.trainable_modules: none for frozen I0; adapter modules only in I1

B_EXTENDED_STATE_HISTORY.attention_position_change: state encoder input width changes; no VL token change
B_EXTENDED_STATE_HISTORY.trainable_modules: state encoder and/or projector per selected recipe

C1_ACTION_SIDE_CONTEXT_TOKENS.insertion: action-side context contribution with original state/action positions preserved
C1_ACTION_SIDE_CONTEXT_TOKENS.action_slice: pred[:, -actions.shape[1]:] with actions.shape[1]=40; final 40 action tokens unchanged

gate.attention_denominator_at_zero: must remain unchanged for original state/action keys
gate.gate_gradient_at_alpha0: may_be_nonzero when R_phi is nonzero: dv/dalpha = R_phi
gate.gradient_claim_boundary: do_not_claim every ContextEncoder/projector parameter receives nonzero gradient at initialization
gate.zero_gate_learning_risk: if the gate-driving residual is also zeroed, the gate gradient may be zero and learning can stall
gate.parity_scope: verify against selected Stage45E base path under identical inputs/noise; concatenation of zero values alone is insufficient

C1_ACTION_SIDE_CONTEXT_TOKENS.attention_position_change: action-side context sequence/mask/position contract must preserve the original state/action path at alpha=0
C1_ACTION_SIDE_CONTEXT_TOKENS.checkpoint_impact: new adapter state and explicit ABI manifest

C2_VL_MEMORY_CONTEXT_TOKENS.insertion: append to encoder_hidden_states / VL cross-attention memory
C2_VL_MEMORY_CONTEXT_TOKENS.context_position_semantics: explicit context positions and mask; no implicit image tokens
C2_VL_MEMORY_CONTEXT_TOKENS.checkpoint_impact: new memory adapter state and explicit ABI manifest

D_EXPLICIT_MEMORY_CROSS_ATTENTION.input_shapes: history memory [B,M,d_model] attended by action/state stream
D_EXPLICIT_MEMORY_CROSS_ATTENTION.attention_position_change: new memory mask, positions, and cross-attention blocks
D_EXPLICIT_MEMORY_CROSS_ATTENTION.trainable_modules: memory/cross-attention plus selected existing modules in I2
D_EXPLICIT_MEMORY_CROSS_ATTENTION.architecture_relation: deeper family; not an alias of C2

c1_gradient_equations.gate: dv/dalpha at alpha=0 = R_phi (may be nonzero)
c1_gradient_equations.claim_boundary: not every context parameter receives nonzero initialization gradient
c1_gradient_equations.stall_condition: zeroing both alpha and R_phi can stall gate learning
